newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close narrowly mixed.

text.p: Rubber futures closed narrowly mixed in moderate trade on Tuesday amid uncertainty over the near-term direction of the market, dealers said.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were also mixed in directionless trade as the spot expiry gave few clues to the market.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on lack of fresh factors. But prices were mixed in the afternoon on some late local buying and selling interest on lack of fresh incentives," a local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, October RSS3 rose two cents to 128.75 U.S. cents a kg.
October RSS1 slipped 0.75 cent to 180.25 Singapore cents (US$1.28) a kg.
October TSR20 rose 0.25 cent to 176.00 Singapore cents (US$1.25) a kg.
